rows.claim: The remaining task designs use title, description, due date and completion status.

evidence.quote: The remaining task screens use only `title`, `description`, `due_date` and `completed`. There are no priority or due-time controls, team features, notification controls or analytics. The original approved Dashboard contains legacy priority badges and a time label: these stay only in that preserved reference and are explicitly excluded from the new component/implementation contract. Their presence must not be interpreted as supported Django fields.

rows.claim: Authentication interactions are visual design states, not account authentication.
rows.notes: No browser or backend tests were performed. See HANDOFF.md for design-only interaction boundaries.
